'''Guy Schiavone''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Merritt Island Grand Slam]] on 4 March 2000 with Scum and Villainy, according to Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d320">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-07-florida-grand-slam-04-march-2000d320/ florida-grand-slam-04-march-2000], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 7 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-07-florida-grand-slam-04-march-2000d320/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
